bead.title: Add hot projection backend capability conformance
bead.description:
PROBLEM
The contract requires every backend to advertise whether it supports hot projection range scans, grouping, side-record queryability, safe bounded mutation, and claim-by-query. Unsupported backends must fail explicitly instead of full-scanning or pretending support.

PROPOSED FIX
Add backend conformance coverage for capability advertising. Memory and sqlite run in CI. Postgres/object-log profiles may be env-gated, but their skips must be loud and their unsupported capability behavior must be explicit. Include negative tests for a backend that lacks a capability.

IN-SCOPE FILES
- crates/pqueue-conformance/ if shared scenarios fit.
- crates/pqueue/tests/hot_projection_queries.rs or backend-specific tests.
- crates/pqueue-server/tests or adapter tests only if needed for env-gated profiles.

OUT-OF-SCOPE
- Implementing postgres/object-log support if not already feasible in this slice.
- Changing unrelated conformance suites.

NEGATIVE-TEST MECHANISM
Do not require a live postgres/object-log instance for the negative capability path: memory and sqlite are expected to support the full capability set, so the "backend without a capability" test needs a test-only stub backend that implements the query port with all hot-projection capabilities advertised unavailable, or an assertion that the port trait's default method implementations return the structured unsupported error. `side_record_query` is advertised unavailable by ALL backends in this epic (implementation deferred; see the epic and contract) — assert that too.
bead.acceptance:
1. `cargo test -p pqueue --test hot_projection_queries backend_capability_advertising_is_explicit -- --nocapture` passes for memory and sqlite.
2. Env-gated postgres/object-log hot projection tests skip loudly when not configured and do not fail local CI.
3. A backend without range scan, grouping, side-record queryability, bounded mutation, or claim-by-query advertises the missing capability and returns a structured unsupported error.
4. `cargo fmt --check` passes.
